title: Feedback and help – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Feedback and help
hero.lead: Use Kaderblick feedback to report a problem, suggest a feature or ask a question. Under My feedback, you can follow progress and replies.

body:
Send feedback

  1. Select the round feedback button at the bottom right of a Kaderblick page.
  2. Select Bug, Feature request, Question or Other.
  3. Describe what you did, what you expected and what actually happened. For a question, describe your objective and where you became stuck.
  4. Enable Attach screenshot if the currently open page matters. Kaderblick hides the feedback dialogue during capture and then shows a preview.
  5. Check that no private or unnecessary content is visible in the screenshot, then select Send.

Track your feedback

Open My feedback. The figures show submitted, outstanding and completed feedback and new replies.

  • Search narrows feedback by its content.
  • All shows all your feedback.
  • Outstanding shows new feedback and feedback being processed.
  • Completed shows closed feedback.
  • When new replies exist, an additional tab and highlighted count appear.

Status and details

  • Outstanding: submitted but not yet marked as read or completed.
  • In progress: administration has opened it or is working on it.
  • Completed: the feedback has been closed.
  • The card shows type, status, submission time, message and, where applicable, comment count, new reply, screenshot or linked GitHub report.

Detailed view and replies

  1. Select feedback to open its detailed view.
  2. Read the thread containing your report, administration replies and your later messages.
  3. Open an attached screenshot using the screenshot action.
  4. If more information is needed, write a reply in the message field and send it.
  5. A new administration reply is marked as read upon opening or through the available read action.

If a GitHub report is linked, the offered link opens the corresponding external page in a new browser window.

Feedback administration

This section is only for platform administrators. It combines Kaderblick feedback and integrated GitHub reports. Search and tabs separate New, In progress and Completed. Authorised users can mark a report as read, complete or reopen it, reply and, where offered, create or open a GitHub report.

Differences by role

  • Signed-in users: can send feedback with the round button and follow only their own feedback under My feedback.
  • Young users and parents: use the same process; an attached screenshot should contain only the part needed for the report.
  • Coaches, cashiers, equipment managers and other club roles: do not gain access to other people’s feedback through their club role.
  • Platform administration: manages all submitted feedback in the separate administration area.

Other ways to get help

  • For a usage question, first check the relevant documentation area or Help by role.
  • For team knowledge and internal guidance, use the Knowledge pool.
  • For direct coordination with team members, use Messages.
